svg.aria-label: The whole system drawn as a circle, its top edge the visible service. From the experiment, a spotlight shines down through the visible service into the system. In the light, interpretation, legislation, operations, decision rights and relationships, each joined to the others by a fine line, passing over and under where they cross. The rest of the circle is hatched and labelled dark matter, and nothing in it can be seen.
svg.title: The whole system as a circle whose top edge is the visible service. Where an experiment goes in, a spotlight opens into the system, and five materials and the relationships between them come into view. Hatching covers the rest, the service's dark matter, where whatever else there is stays hidden
